snippet.title: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy - Trailer - Oct. 2026
snippet.description:
This updated trailer shows off some of the gameplay in Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy, including achievements you can earn. You can also hear a sample of the voice acting in the game.

Dragon's Isle Software is a 4 person family team creating indie games. Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is one of two games we are currently working on developing for release on Steam and itch.io. It is a short action-adventure game, set in a puzzle dungeon created to serve as a year 1 exam for adventuring students. Fight enemies, solve puzzles, avoid traps, and collect the treasures. Show your teachers what you learned in class!

Our content is human made. We do not use Gen AI in any part of our game dev or videos.

Wishlist or play our demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5196730/Eldwyns_Dungeon_Academy/

Play our in-browser demo on itch.io:
https://dragonsisle.itch.io/eldwyns-dungeon-academy
